propositions: When a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link, close_precheck falls through to the completion verifier, which synthesizes an incorrect resolution claim and fails without naming the required action.
A hard fail must be raised before any LLM call when closing a bug as duplicate with no replacement link, emitting a CommandError that names the exact rebar link command needed.
The gate must require the duplicates link to exist but not require its target to be open, since closing a duplicate of an already-closed canonical is common.
The hard fail must distinguish between a dead/archived named target and having named no link at all, with distinct error messages for each case.
The scope of the hard fail is duplicate class only; not_a_bug and escalated must preserve the existing fallthrough behavior since they do not owe a duplicates link.
